questions.prompt: What falls from clouds when it rains?
questions.evidenceText: It is rainy. Drops fall from the clouds. Drip, drip, drip.

questions.prompt: What appears after rain in the book?
questions.evidenceText: After rain, look up! A rainbow! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.

questions.prompt: What happens to leaves when the wind blows hard?
questions.evidenceText: It is windy. The wind blows hard. Leaves fly in the air.
